name: Yuexi
source:
A prototype of the beast known as a gu diao. It seems that she has a long, deep relationship with Bai Ze (Fuling) and now appears to be enslaved(?) by her alongside her younger brother, Hizuna.

She is very short-tempered and strong, yet she doesn't even have the desire to ravage a weak opponent. It's not impossible to say that she is acting in principle... Her inhuman, bird-like feet were deliberately made by her. She doesn't want to be exactly like a human.

She seems to have been much more domineering in the past before her powers were restricted. Liike her younger brother, she still maintains the appearance of a child. (Perhaps unconsciously, her mind has also been affected to some extent.)

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1685630/_/]Steam[/url]]
